ModMetaData.name: Expanded Tribals Xenotype
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description: I felt the VFE Tribals wild man was disappointing that it could only spawn baseliners; but i understand it doesn't really interact with biotech either; so i decided to make a mod to patch the list with any xenotype you want; even remove baseliners from the list.
